name: Workbench Feature Showcase
summary: Interactive examples of all catalog primitives, control kinds, local action kinds and UI states, with explicit parity diagnostics.
outcome: Generate an editable UI showcase with deterministic read fixtures; inspect remaining native authoring and menu-action gaps.
includes: All 10 control kinds and seven local action kinds
Five UI states and three responsive layout modes
Props, slots, events, variants and a pinned component revision
Routes, journeys, source fixtures and native integration declarations
implementation: Inspect modeled coverage separately from behavioral and native acceptance.
Menu item action callbacks remain unsupported in the current catalog and are explicitly disabled.
Real persistence and full native Companion authoring are not implemented by this example.

notes:
# Showcase scope

This project demonstrates the shipped visual compiler contract, not completion of native Companion authoring. Every example is editable. Use the coverage report to inspect unsupported authoring adapters and unbound interactions. Fixture execution is local and separate from real business persistence.

files.content:
# Workbench feature showcase

Edit the definition in configs/starters/feature-showcase.json before generation. Inspect generated design/project.json afterwards. Use npm run verify:project and npm run build:clickdummy to check the generated project. Synthetic read data is local. Menu item callbacks and full native authoring parity remain explicit gaps; see starters coverage.

processes.label: Install dependencies
processes.description: Explicitly install the generated lockfile; no global packages.

processes.label: Verify generated project
processes.description: Run generated build, types and tests. Native acceptance is separate.

processes.label: Build offline UI preview
processes.description: Compile generated Vue source into the standalone clickdummy; not the authoring HTML.

processes.label: Preview generated source
processes.description: Foreground, loopback-only fixture preview. Stop with Ctrl+C.
